summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature in the MONAI repository without running tests or committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch yields (patch view, coords) pairs with coordinates computed from padding offsets, docstring updated; set_rnd skips dunder attributes). monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter generator; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates, with len() check, worker partitioning via integer ceiling, per-patch transform via apply_transform with map_items=False; math import removed; PatchDataset docstring uses float). monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter. docs/source/data.rst gets a PatchIter autodoc entry after GridPatchDataset. tests/test_grid_dataset.py added with test_shape, test_loading_array (pinned single-process and two-worker values), and an extra test_missing_length. Unverified: the pinned patch values and two-worker batch order, since tests were not run. Pre-existing lines 233-235 of utils.py exceed 120 characters and were left alone.
